title: Bechet's bad business sense
summary: Bechet bought poor property, spent on equipment and had a failed mink farm.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: at that time we once went up to Harlem to see him when he was living in a basement with John Reed and he knew John was somewhat of a better businessman than he was that's when he was playing the opera for us yeah and he'd just bought a summer place over in New Jersey probably in the swamp lands you know like in the near the Hackensack River some real dump where nobody would ever have wanted to build but he bought a place over there right along one of those awful rivers that wasn't any good at all yeah and John was trying to tell him politely you know he shouldn't have done it yeah yeah and I know other times he'd spend all of his money on cameras and equipment oh yeah cars and everything else
and he had a mink farm
well I think I remember something I heard about that
was it in the Mohawk Valley someplace up there yeah and he was going to go up to try to raise mink well that never worked out either no he wasn't much of a businessman
I guess he had a lot of fun in his life though
